verdict.rationale: Docs show onboarding lets you choose a model source such as your existing ChatGPT/Codex or SuperGrok subscription instead of managing API keys, which supports sign-in-with-account convenience, but there is no explicit mention of a 'free tier' being granted via personal account login. missing for 10: explicit free-tier/no-cost access confirmation, details on how account sign-in works (OAuth flow), independent confirmation that no API key is ever required.
